ghats.name: Dharmapuri Godavari River Bathing Ghat
ghats.description: Sacred riverbank with a long flight of stone steps where Godavari performs a rare turn to flow North to South (Dakshina Vahini). Features clean sandy beds, evening Godavari Harathi, Pinda Pradaan rituals, and overhead river water showers.

significance: At Dharmapuri, River Godavari turns southward as Dakshina Vahini. Taking a holy dip (Punya Snanam / Pushkara Snanam) in this south-flowing river cleanses sins and bestows divine merit.

pushkaralu_2027.rituals: Pushkara Snanam (dawn Arunodaya bath), Pinda Pradaanam (ancestral rites), Pitru Tarpanam (water offerings with sesame seeds), Daanam & Dharma (charity).

safety_rules: During monsoon surges, heavy upstream dam inflow causes rapid water rise and flood alerts, submerging lower steps. Heavy-duty security nets, anchored floating ropes, and bamboo barricades define safe boundaries. Stationed lifeguards on boats with lifebuoys and overhead multi-nozzle river water shower systems are deployed during peak events.
